unir-pdf.title: Merge PDF
unir-pdf.description: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document with cover thumbnails and free drag-and-drop reordering.

separar-pdf.title: Split PDF
separar-pdf.description: Extract specific page ranges (e.g. 1-3, 5, 8-10) or split every page into individual files in a .zip.

organizar-paginas.title: Organize & Edit Pages
organizar-paginas.description: View every page in a grid to rotate 90°, delete, duplicate, or reorder pages freely.

pdf-imagenes.title: PDF to JPG / PNG & Vice Versa
pdf-imagenes.description: Export PDF pages as crisp images (.zip) or merge JPG, PNG, and WebP images into one PDF.

firmar-pdf.title: Sign PDF
firmar-pdf.description: Draw your signature, type it in calligraphy, or upload a transparent PNG and place it anywhere.

marca-agua-numeracion.title: Watermark & Page Numbers
marca-agua-numeracion.description: Add custom text watermarks or page numbering (Page X of Y) adjusting opacity, color, size, and position.

proteger-desbloquear.title: Protect & Unlock PDF
proteger-desbloquear.description: Encrypt your PDFs with a password or remove the password from your own protected documents.

pdf-a-word.title: PDF to Word (.docx)
pdf-a-word.description: Accurate conversion preserving tables, columns, fonts, and images, with optional OCR for scans.

pdf-to-excel.title: PDF to Excel
pdf-to-excel.description: Extract tables from your PDF and download them as an editable Excel spreadsheet
pdf-to-excel.pageSubtitle: Upload your PDF with tables and download it in Excel ready to edit. 100% free and no sign-up.

comprimir-pdf.title: Compress PDF
comprimir-pdf.description: Reduce PDF file size choosing from 3 compression levels (Extreme, Recommended, Low) with visible savings.
